themes.title: Far-Right Surge in European Regional Elections and Governance
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are celebrating key governance milestones, leading national polls, and preparing for power-sharing or presidential bids. From Giorgia Meloni's record tenure in Italy to surge polling for the AfD in Germany and FrP in Norway, conservative factions are solidifying mainstream political power.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP leads polls with a historic 31.4% share, positioning Sylvi Listhaug as a direct rival to the Prime Minister.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD surges to 42% in polls ahead of the Saxony-Anhalt state election.

countries.note: RN consolidates right-wing alliances and secures endorsement signatures ahead of the 2027 presidential race.

themes.title: Immigration and Border Security as Political Wedges
themes.blurb: Conservative and far-right movements continue to leverage immigration, border control, and identity policy as central political platforms. Measures range from federal deportation raids in the US to proposed bans on Islamic symbols and municipal anti-Islamization packages in Europe.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Administration expands ICE enforcement operations and defends executive orders targeting birthright citizenship.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen proposes a national referendum to ban the Islamic headscarf in public spaces.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD introduces an anti-Islamization package in Gothenburg targeting mosque construction and public funding.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini calls for aggressive crackdowns on irregular migration while local officials challenge mosque funding.

themes.title: Economic Nationalism and Trade Disputes
themes.blurb: Right-wing factions are prioritizing national energy independence, domestic production, and economic sovereignty over international regulations. Leaders are actively sanctioning foreign extraction firms, fast-tracking domestic oil and gas projects, and challenging international climate frameworks.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei asserts Malvinas sovereignty and imposes legal sanctions against foreign companies exploiting Falkland oil.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Administration fast-tracks Arctic oil drilling, expands coastal energy leases, and threatens foreign trade tariffs.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Party leadership campaigns to maximize North Sea oil and gas extraction and eliminate green energy levies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN opposes EU climate regulations in favor of domestic industrial protection and energy cost reductions.

themes.title: Nationalist Symbolism and Rebranding of Public Institutions
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments are increasingly deploying state power to redesign public spaces, reshape educational institutions, and enforce patriotic imagery. Efforts include architectural monuments, landmark renaming, revoking privileges from opposition institutions, and penalizing university diversity programs.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Pushes capital architectural projects, proposes landmark name changes, and threatens tax exemptions for DEI programs.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei utilizes national broadcasts to emphasize patriotic symbolism and announce strategic military base construction.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Legislators pass measures revoking lifelong financial benefits for former state presidents.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Government uses national longevity milestones and regional appointments to reshape cultural and educational policy.

themes.title: Right-Wing Parties Battle Electoral Rules and Funding Scrutiny
themes.blurb: Across several democracies, right-wing parties are locked in disputes surrounding election mechanics, campaign finance laws, and electoral integrity. While US conservatives push voting restrictions through the courts, European populist parties face scrutiny over election funding and candidate qualification rules.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Petitions Supreme Court to enforce mail-in voting restrictions ahead of midterm elections.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Faces police referral following an undercover investigation into alleged illegal foreign polling donations.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Attacks the 500-signature presidential endorsement requirement as a flawed institutional barrier.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni coalition advances electoral reform bill changing preference voting mechanics in the Senate.
